findings.priority_reason: 影響する機能を製品で信頼する前に対応する。依存と受入条件を先に確定する。
findings.title: 合成後の状態上限を検査せず、更新できない状態を正常保存する
findings.root_cause: Separate input schemas validate current and upserts, but merged output lacks full state-schema validation.
findings.condition: Valid1000-fact saved state plus1new valid fact, no removals.
findings.consequence: Returns ok:true and persists1001facts; all later updates reject state_schema_unsupported_or_invalid and forgetting also cannot parse it. Data remains raw but normal API recovery fails.
findings.counterevidence: Remove-and-add within the same proposal can remain bounded; this workaround does not justify accepting a normal invalid add. SQLite transaction alone cannot prevent a logically invalid success.
findings.fix: Validate the complete candidate with the existing collaborationStateSchema before success/adoption; reject overflow with an actionable reason and preserve old state/receipt. Any semantic consolidation/removal remains LLM/user-directed, not silent truncation.
findings.verification: 999+1 succeeds;1000+1 refuses atomically and preserves state/no receipt;1000-1+1 succeeds; next valid update and forgetting remain possible. Existing suites and pack consumption remain unchanged.

impacts.reason: Success output can violate the declared state contract.
Existing tests miss valid-input composition overflow.

findings.priority_reason: 影響する機能を製品で信頼する前に対応する。依存と受入条件を先に確定する。
findings.title: 却下済み・未確定の代替案が確定条件を撤回できる
findings.root_cause: Retraction applies to every supersedes edge regardless of replacing status/evidence; graph validity alone does not enforce status transition contract.
findings.condition: A rejected replacement references active assistant source and supersedes a confirmed user condition.
findings.consequence: The confirmed condition becomes retracted despite no accepted replacement; downstream work reading active conditions can lose an agreed requirement.
findings.counterevidence: Confirmed corrections with real user/observation evidence work and existing cycle/source checks hold. Explicit contract currently does not state the accepted/proposed edge behavior precisely, which must be resolved.
findings.fix: Specify supersession status semantics. Enforce that proposed/rejected alternatives cannot invalidate accepted conditions; only a status-authorized accepted replacement triggers retraction. Reuse state proposal/host evidence checks, no utterance-specific branch.
findings.verification: A matrix over proposed/rejected/retracted/confirmed replacement statuses and user/assistant evidence preserves prior confirmed facts until accepted; existing correction/forgetting tests continue passing.

impacts.reason: No executable rejected-alternative state transition coverage despite inventory task.

findings.priority_reason: 次の関連リリース・製品採用より前に対処する。
findings.title: 終了・計画の意味判断が語句と固定規則へ戻っている
findings.root_cause: Normalizing away punctuation and matching DONE lists substitutes for intent interpretation; segmentation/output lists and unconditional first-step browser override LLM judgment.
findings.condition: User asks confirmation with question punctuation or an offline calculation/translation; caller uses newly exported session/plan helpers.
findings.consequence: A question is closed with high confidence; first offline step is forced to browser. Vocabulary-specific maintenance grows and core violates its own declared generality. Helpers are currently not connected to example, so product impact is conditional.
findings.counterevidence: Some browser choices are delegated to an agent; cited explicit URLs and provided brief slots can legitimately be structural inputs. New helper callers are currently tests only.
findings.fix: Reuse the existing model/schema proposal path for intent/session/step/browser decisions, passing full context and available tools. Keep code to validating schema, references, allowed operations and budgets. Retain counterexamples as regressions, not new dictionary entries.
findings.verification: Paraphrase/question/negation/multilingual and online/offline task sets accepted through a bounded LLM evaluation; no new phrase-specific product branches; host authorization and budgets still enforced.

impacts.reason: History shows additional vocabulary branches without general resolution.

findings.priority_reason: 次の関連リリース・製品採用より前に対処する。
findings.title: 外部処理中のプロセス終了後に状態を照合し直せない
findings.root_cause: No persisted attempt ownership/expiry/reconciliation transition; caught exceptions handle unknown but abrupt process exit bypasses catch.
findings.condition: Example host exits after recording queued or stopping, before awaiting port response; restarts with same SQLite and no completion event.
findings.consequence: queued can remain ambiguous indefinitely; stopping short-circuits every later stop call, with no supported reconciliation path. Avoids duplicates but does not restore a truthful actionable state.
findings.counterevidence: Replayed requests are correctly not automatically resent, and explicit transport exceptions become unknown. A real host can reconcile externally, but this adapter has no entry for the missing stop/delivery result.
findings.fix: Use existing host job/receipt/lifecycle source of truth to reconcile interrupted attempts to unknown or observed final state; expose a safe explicit reconciliation path with attempt/generation checks. Do not blindly resend.
findings.verification: Abrupt child-process exit before/after external acknowledgement; reopen with same DB; repeated request never duplicates effects and stale stopping becomes externally reconcilable; old callbacks cannot overwrite new epoch.

impacts.reason: Crash windows preserve an unusable in-flight state rather than recoverable uncertainty.
Reconstruction-after-throw does not cover real process exit.

findings.title: 固定Zod版の配列検査が入力上限より先に大量処理する
findings.root_cause: Pinned vulnerable direct dependency; collection size gate runs after element parsing.
findings.condition: Oversized invalid collection is passed to public schema/proposeStateUpdate.
findings.consequence: Zod4.4.3 is affected by known resource-consumption advisory; max1000 still walks2001bad elements and accumulates2002issues. Large-input resource growth is reachable in the library. No remote/OOM exploit demonstrated.
findings.counterevidence: Schemas do reject final oversized input. Host ingress/model limits may bound exposure; library itself has no network endpoint. Advisory High is therefore not assigned as project High.
findings.fix: Coordinate minimal patched Zod update with Eumenes (advisory patched4.6.6+) and retain host ingress byte/count limits before costly parsing. Validate actual runtime compatibility; do not merely ignore audit or weaken schemas.
findings.verification: Production audit no longer reports this advisory; oversize invalid array rejects before per-element issue growth; frozen install, core57tests and host601parity/pack checks pass.

impacts.reason: Declared max is not an effective early resource bound.
Known affected direct dependency remains fixed.
